operator_recovery.note: Command wall time includes the resume HTTP call plus one normal bounded projection iteration and can exceed the resume call deadline. The harness resumes engines serially while supervised workers run in parallel; catch-up polling begins later, so zero wait does not imply instantaneous rebuilding. Endpoint cleanup is not separately timed, neither duration is full rebuild throughput, and operator iteration may contribute to publications. Counts do not replace final dirty/coverage/query checks.

operator_resume_timeout_fix.boundary: 504 status extracted as a marker and file hash only; no private command body, credentials or recorded IO copied. First ON poll is not a pure cleanup duration or full ready coverage proof.

startup_lifecycle_ownership_fix.root_cause: A redundant ingest initializer could revoke a successfully initialized provider generation on metadata error without a remaining retry owner
startup_lifecycle_ownership_fix.fix: The production OceanBase provider owns initialization/retry; an internal config marker prevents duplicate ingest initialization for that same provider/DSN/prefix. Standalone zero-value bootstrap and emergency writer fencing remain unchanged.
startup_lifecycle_ownership_fix.boundary: Offline SQL-mock regression and source-wiring checks, then final whole-package compilation/tests and source-bound query/helper replay. Full SigNoz service startup and runtime metadata-failure injection remain unrun.

batched_source_enrollment_fix.source_binding_boundary: Shared read_model.go changes for reviewed publication; the two enrollment methods retain exact reviewed text, while the entire final file is bound to Go afterHashes and the publication candidate separately
batched_source_enrollment_fix.invariants: Same maintenance fence, RC transaction, revision+1/dirty marking, atomic coverage cursor, 25-Trace chunks and 2s outer soft budget; validate the complete page before any source write
batched_source_enrollment_fix.real_sql_scope: Existing concurrent-maintenance test includes mixed old/new revisions, physical summary refresh, unchanged other-org source and stale-publication rejection; both final engine SQL runs are separately required above
batched_source_enrollment_fix.boundary: Statement-count reduction is structural, not a throughput/latency/SLO ratio. Intermediate incomplete CE rebuild is retained separately; only final source-bound serving and fully completed rebuild are accepted.

bounded_publication_transactions_fix.invariants: One RC transaction and shared maintenance fence per at-most-25-item chunk; every source FOR UPDATE, generation/physical-scope/revision CAS, projection INSERT and dirty UPDATE retained. Ordered receipts leave the chunk only after Commit. SQL/Commit error returns no successful batch response; current uncommitted chunk rolls back while earlier chunks may remain committed. The next chunk reacquires the fence and honors newer OFF.
bounded_publication_transactions_fix.real_sql_scope: Both final engine SQL logs explicitly pass the 26-item chunk-boundary subcase: 25 valid, one stale, clean/revision counts and unchanged other organization
bounded_publication_transactions_fix.boundary: Transaction/fence count reduction is structural, not a measured throughput ratio. Item count does not establish a two-second lock duration or ingestion-latency SLO. Ordinary 30-second publication request deadline is unchanged.

operator_deadline_middleware_regression.boundary: Actual middleware context deadlines observed immediately; no long wait or database access. Final operator E2E runs through the same real timeout middleware.

maintenance_lock_fix.boundary: Historical single diagnostics identify fence contention, not paired final performance. Work budget is checked between committed chunks; no hard per-chunk latency guarantee.
